+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages)
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        roots = data["roots"]
+        rows_by_name = {name: {row["version"]: row for row in rows}
+                        for name, rows in packages.items()}
+        domains = []
+        for name in names:
+            versions = sorted(rows_by_name[name])
+            versions = [v for v in versions if v not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                        and (name not in pins or pins[name] == v)]
+            domains.append([-1] + versions)
+
+        best = None
+        for vector in product(*domains):
+            assigned = dict(zip(names, vector))
+            installed = {name: version for name, version in assigned.items() if version != -1}
+            if any(name not in installed or not low <= installed[name] <= high
+                   for name, (low, high) in roots.items()):
+                continue
+
+            edges = {}
+            constraints_ok = True
+            for name, version in installed.items():
+                row = rows_by_name[name][version]
+                active = [dep for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                          if not dep.get("feature") or dep.get("feature") in features]
+                edges[name] = []
+                for dep in active:
+                    other = dep["name"]
+                    edges[name].append(other)
+                    if other not in installed or not dep["min"] <= installed[other] <= dep["max"]:
+                        constraints_ok = False
+                        break
+                if not constraints_ok:
+                    break
+            if not constraints_ok:
+                continue
+
+            closure = set()
+            stack = list(roots)
+            while stack:
+                name = stack.pop()
+                if name in closure:
+                    continue
+                if name not in installed:
+                    constraints_ok = False
+                    break
+                closure.add(name)
+                stack.extend(edges.get(name, []))
+            if not constraints_ok or closure != set(installed):
+                continue
+
+            state, cyclic = {}, False
+            def visit(name):
+                nonlocal cyclic
+                if state.get(name) == 1:
+                    cyclic = True
+                    return
+                if state.get(name) == 2:
+                    return
+                state[name] = 1
+                for other in edges.get(name, []):
+                    visit(other)
+                state[name] = 2
+            for name in installed:
+                visit(name)
+            if cyclic:
+                continue
+
+            if best is None or vector < best:
+                best = vector
+
+        if best is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": {name: version for name, version in zip(names, best)
+                              if version != -1}}
     return solve
